newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bombs explode in three Corsican homes.
newsitem.headline: Bombs explode in three Corsican homes.

text.p: Bombs ripped through three uninhabited homes on the southern tip of the Mediterranean island of Corsica late on Thursday causing serious damage, police sources said.
The explosions in the hamlet of San Gravino di Carbini, near Porto Vecchio, blew out windows in a nearby occupied house and caused a two-year-old boy inside to suffer hearing problems.

The three empty homes belonged to a businessman whose property has been the target of previous attacks by Corsican separatists waging a two-decade long guerrilla campaign for greater autonomy from mainland France.

No one immediately claimed responsibility for the attack. Both Corsican separatists and local criminals set off hundreds of bombs each year on the restive island to further their political aims or as part of extortion attempts.
